# Bhadeya Technical Services LLC

> UAE specialist in GPR (Ground Penetrating Radar) scanning, diamond core cutting, and excavation services. Founded 2019, based in Dubai, operating across all 6 UAE Emirates. Trusted by Dubai Mall, Emaar, ADNOC, Kempinski, and Sheikh Khalifa Hospital.

## Services

- GPR Scanning (Proceq GP8000): https://www.bhadeya.com/services/gpr-scanning
- GPR Scanning Dubai (landing page): https://www.bhadeya.com/gpr-scanning-dubai
- Core Cutting: https://www.bhadeya.com/services/core-cutting
- Excavation: https://www.bhadeya.com/services/excavation
- PM8000 Rebar Scanning: https://www.bhadeya.com/services/pm8000-scanning
- GS8000 Ground Scanning: https://www.bhadeya.com/services/gs8000-scanning
- Oversized Cargo Movement: https://www.bhadeya.com/services/oversized-cargo

## Key Facts

- Equipment: Proceq GP8000 (GPR, 500cm depth), Profometer PM8000 (rebar cover ±1mm), Proceq GS8000 (large-scale, 10m depth)
- GPR accuracy: ±10mm under ideal conditions
- Core cutting diameter range: 12mm to 500mm
- Founded: 2019 — 7+ years experience
- Projects completed: 500+
- Service area: Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, Ras Al Khaimah, Fujairah, Al Ain (all UAE)
- Business hours: Sun–Thu 8AM–6PM, Sat 9AM–3PM (UAE time)
- Contact: +971 55 692 6286
